# Termux-STT Full Technical Specification (v1.0.0)
Official Documentation & Deep Architecture Reference for Autonomous AI Agents.

## 1. System Overview
Unified On-Device Speech-to-Text & Pure-Python 128d Speaker Diarization Framework
Unifies Whisper.cpp, Vosk, and Sherpa-ONNX with pure-Python 128d speaker diarization running 100% on-device.

## 2. Package & Installation
- PyPI: termux-stt
- Command: pip install termux-stt
# or:
npm install termux-stt
- Repository: https://github.com/uno-km/termux-stt
